title: Edmund and the Safehouse
author: Sebastian Eriksen
blurb: Petra Ishikawa, a burnt analyst bounced from three agencies, keeps a go-bag packed and a lie polished. Then a voiceprint unlocks a server on another continent — and he is pulled straight into the middle of it. To get through this, he must burn the network that did the training before the markets open in Frankfurt.
style: vivid, cinematic prose with tight pacing
